Moving forward, I will continue to articulate my perspectives with clarity and confidence, emphasizing the interplay between risk management and organizational culture. Understanding this dynamic will help me anticipate the contours of future debates and prepare contributions that bridge these priorities.

My main takeaway is that establishing a culture of psychological safety and disciplined learning early on is as vital as financial strategy.
